description: Evaluation component of MÖVE, a German public-sector LLM benchmark. Python framework for benchmarking LLMs across tasks (summarization, QA, classification, topic extraction) and providers (OpenAI-compatible APIs, Azure, Ollama), with metrics for task performance, energy use, and German-constitutional-values alignment.
